cases.scope: Matched original real dependency closure; first diagnostic probe, no full app compatibility claim

limitations: Explicit Java public static imports, aliases, inherited overloads/fields and ordinary calls; static-member wildcard and static-interface method imports remain explicit unsupported boundaries.

Synthetic getter/setter properties on ordinary concrete Java-class receivers, including generic Java classes and inherited accessibility bridges. Interface, enum, Kotlin and mapped java.lang receiver/origin cases remain explicitly unsupported where source classifier provenance is required.

Public non-generic builtin-class functions are decoded by declaration, retaining parameter names, nullability and JVM signatures. Raw Object calls are limited to matching kotlin.Any declarations; actual JVM implementations execute normally.
String platform concatenation uses the existing String concatenation operation; Unit operands explicitly reject. Nullable String receiver extension operators remain a separate existing boundary.

Selected unchanged upstream original and AndroidBible app test progress are separate from whole-app compatibility. Java callers compile once against official output and reuse identical bytecodes; official Kotlin consumers compile against each output.
No Android-device execution, full-app, production, performance or exhaustive upstream-suite claim.
